WITH
  "menura_1_scan" AS (
    SELECT
      "account_id" AS "ACCOUNT_ID"
    FROM "shop"."main"."accounts"
  ),
  "menura_2_filter" AS (
    SELECT
      "ACCOUNT_ID"
    FROM "menura_1_scan"
    WHERE "ACCOUNT_ID" IS NOT NULL
  ),
  "menura_3_aggregate" AS (
    SELECT
      "ACCOUNT_ID" AS "ACCOUNT_ID",
      CAST(COUNT(*) AS BIGINT) AS "menura.row_count"
    FROM "menura_2_filter"
    GROUP BY 1
  ),
  "menura_4_filter" AS (
    SELECT
      "ACCOUNT_ID",
      "menura.row_count"
    FROM "menura_3_aggregate"
    WHERE "menura.row_count" > 1
  ),
  "menura_5_project" AS (
    SELECT
      "ACCOUNT_ID" AS "ACCOUNT_ID",
      "menura.row_count" AS "row_count"
    FROM "menura_4_filter"
  )
SELECT
  "ACCOUNT_ID",
  "row_count"
FROM "menura_5_project"

WITH
  "menura_1_scan" AS (
    SELECT
      "account_id" AS "ACCOUNT_ID"
    FROM "shop"."main"."balances"
  ),
  "menura_2_filter" AS (
    SELECT
      "ACCOUNT_ID"
    FROM "menura_1_scan"
    WHERE "ACCOUNT_ID" IS NOT NULL
  ),
  "menura_3_scan" AS (
    SELECT
      "account_id" AS "BALANCES_ACCOUNTS.ACCOUNT_ID"
    FROM "shop"."main"."accounts"
  ),
  "menura_4_join" AS (
    SELECT
      "ACCOUNT_ID",
      "BALANCES_ACCOUNTS.ACCOUNT_ID"
    FROM "menura_2_filter"
    LEFT JOIN "menura_3_scan" ON "menura_2_filter"."ACCOUNT_ID" = "menura_3_scan"."BALANCES_ACCOUNTS.ACCOUNT_ID"
  ),
  "menura_5_filter" AS (
    SELECT
      "ACCOUNT_ID",
      "BALANCES_ACCOUNTS.ACCOUNT_ID"
    FROM "menura_4_join"
    WHERE "BALANCES_ACCOUNTS.ACCOUNT_ID" IS NULL
  ),
  "menura_6_project" AS (
    SELECT
      "ACCOUNT_ID" AS "ACCOUNT_ID"
    FROM "menura_5_filter"
  )
SELECT
  "ACCOUNT_ID"
FROM "menura_6_project"

WITH
  "menura_1_scan" AS (
    SELECT
      "account_id" AS "ACCOUNT_ID",
      "snapshot" AS "SNAPSHOT"
    FROM "shop"."main"."balances"
  ),
  "menura_2_snapshots" AS (
    SELECT
      "ACCOUNT_ID",
      "SNAPSHOT" AS "menura.period"
    FROM "menura_1_scan"
    WHERE "ACCOUNT_ID" IS NOT NULL AND "SNAPSHOT" IS NOT NULL
  )
SELECT
  "ACCOUNT_ID" AS "ACCOUNT_ID",
  "menura.period" AS "SNAPSHOT",
  'duplicate_snapshot' AS "violation"
FROM "menura_2_snapshots"
GROUP BY 1, 2
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
